p: Kirjathjearim came: A city in the tribe of Judah, called also Kirjathbaal, in Jos 15:60.
after the LORD: Lamented for their sins, and followed the Lord.
Mizpeh: For Shiloh was now desolate, because the Philistines had taken the ark from it.
drew water: The Chaldee text says that they drew water out of their heart: that is, wept abundantly for their sins.
cry unto the LORD our God: Signifying that in the prayers of the godly, there should be a vehement zeal.
thundered with a great thunder on: According to the prophecy of Hannah Samuel's mother, 1Sa 2:10.
Shen: Which was a great rock over against Mizpeh.
altar unto the LORD: Which was not contrary to the Law: for as yet a certain place was not appointed.
